purpose: Track upstream model availability separately from CT Edu output generation, technical checks, independent evaluation, anatomical review and approval for educational use.

statusDefinitions.not-implemented: No usable implementation or upstream model path has been selected.
statusDefinitions.model-available-not-evaluated: The pinned upstream model advertises this class, but CT Edu has not generated or evaluated it.
statusDefinitions.prediction-generated: A model output exists for a named source study; generation alone does not establish correctness.
statusDefinitions.technically-validated: Output integrity, spatial geometry and artifact alignment passed declared software checks. This state is not an anatomical-accuracy claim.
statusDefinitions.independently-evaluated: Per-structure performance evaluated on independent, appropriately licensed held-out cases.
statusDefinitions.anatomically-reviewed: Qualified anatomical reviewer has recorded a review against the intended educational definition.
statusDefinitions.approved-for-educational-use: Required technical, independent evaluation, rights, accessibility and human-review gates are satisfied.

currentSPLInput.coordinateSystem: RAS after conversion from NRRD LPS
currentSPLInput.sourceIntensitySemantics: Stored int16 source values; HU calibration is not independently confirmed.
currentSPLInput.limitation: The packaged NRRD header does not declare an explicit HU unit, modality, rescale slope or intercept; window/level values are display metadata, not calibration proof.

safetyAndInterpretation.outputRightsReview: Open. The TotalSegmentator task license and the SPL source-data/license/derivative-use review are separate issues; no broader educational-use approval is implied.

upstreamSources.taskLicenseEvidence: The pinned README states that the total task (117 CT classes) is openly available for any usage under Apache-2.0. Specialist tasks have their own entries and may have license requirements.
upstreamSources.weightsRedistribution: CT Edu does not vendor model weights. Review exact model artifact/weight terms separately before redistributing any weights.
upstreamSources.sourceAtlasRights: SPL Abdominal Atlas is separately covered by the source package's 3D Slicer License Part B notice; third-party rights and redistribution review remain open.

implementationSummary.note: The first four classes passed software/geometry checks and have same-volume Dice values; no class has independent held-out evaluation, qualified anatomical review or approval for broader educational use.

currentInferenceConfiguration.note: The generator code now computes exact source-member SHA-256 hashes, writes millimetre units and publishes atomically with failure recovery. The currently committed preview manifest has not yet been regenerated with these source hashes, so sourceInputHashesAvailableOnMain remains false. The 1024 preprocessing offset remains an unverified hypothesis.

notes: This utility processes a supplied local NIfTI and writes masks plus provenance without copying the CT into its output directory.
It does not alter the precomputed SPL preview assets and does not add a public upload endpoint.

By default it selects the four major abdominal classes, but it can also select any of the 117 pinned TotalSegmentator 2.11.0 total-task classes, including supported upstream vessel and vertebral classes.
A selectable upstream class is not a generated, independently evaluated, anatomically reviewed, or educationally approved CT Edu class.
The all-classes mode was not run by this change; its runtime, memory and artifact cost must be measured on a suitable controlled host.
Input intensity semantics must be explicitly declared; this does not independently prove Hounsfield-unit calibration.

classSelection.outputPolicy: Separate binary NIfTI masks remain authoritative; combined uint8 label IDs are assigned in selection order and report overlap counts.
